name: Runner Extras - SQL Connection OOS
brief: Issue #5190: any Ncl path that opens a SQL connection died with an unnamed NullReferenceException out of NavSqlConnectionScope.TryOpenConnection, because the runner's skeleton database has no database server. TaskScheduler.TaskExists/CancelTask (#2866) and raising an [ExternalBusinessEvent] (#5149) were fixed one by one; this is the backstop for every other surface. Database.AlterKey is the AL statement this suite drives: it reaches BC's SQL layer through no runner patch. The refusal must name the API, cite docs/scope.md#sql-connection, name the BC frame that asked, and tear through an AL TryFunction instead of reading as a quiet false (a guarded Codeunit.Run swallows every exception whatever raised it, tracked as #5342).
description: Runner-specific by construction: which surface the runner refuses, under which name, and that the per-surface refusals it already has are not replaced by this one. Whether BC's Database.AlterKey succeeds against a SQL Server is not asserted here.
